- entry_count = COUNT(*)

**Discriminator**: `group_by` = `"grand_total"` — returned when the `groupBy` query parameter is omitted from the request.

**Invariant**: total_hours = billable_hours + non_billable_hours

**Edge Cases**:
- No matching timelogs: all hour values = 0, entry_count = 0
- All hours are non-negative numbers
- entry_count is always a non-negative integer

group_by.description:
Discriminator constant identifying this entry as a task-grouped aggregation in the time report.

The value is always "task" for this schema variant. When the time report is requested with group_by=task, each result entry uses this schema, grouping timelogs by their associated task.
group_by.x-autobe-specification: Constant discriminator value "task" identifying this schema as the task-grouped variant of the time report union type. Used by the oneOf discriminator to select this variant when group_by equals 'task'. Not derived from any database column.

taskId.description:
Unique identifier of the task this group represents.

When not null, this is the UUID of the erp_hrm_tasks record that the aggregated timelogs are assigned to. When null, this entry aggregates all timelogs that have no task assignment — the title will read "Unassigned" in that case.
taskId.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from erp_hrm_tasks.id via LEFT JOIN on erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id = erp_hrm_tasks.id. Set to null when the grouping key (timelog task_id) is null, representing timelogs with no task assignment. All timelogs sharing the same non-null task_id are grouped under this UUID value.

title.description:
Display title of the task, or the literal string "Unassigned" when taskId is null.

Provides human-readable identification of each task group in the report output. When taskId is null, "Unassigned" identifies the synthetic group collecting all timelogs without a task assignment.
title.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from erp_hrm_tasks.title via LEFT JOIN on erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id = erp_hrm_tasks.id. Set to the literal string "Unassigned" when the grouping key is null (no task associated with the timelogs in this group). For non-null taskId, this is the title field from the joined erp_hrm_tasks row.

total_hours.description:
Total aggregated work hours for this task group.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations in minutes divided by 60. Includes both billable and non-billable hours. Rounded to two decimal places.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as ROUND(SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2) for all timelogs in the group. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs. Deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) are excluded from the sum.

billable_hours.description:
Aggregated billable work hours for this task group.

Computed from timelogs where billable is true. Used in client billing calculations and project budget comparisons. Rounded to two decimal places.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true THEN erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2). Only timelogs where billable is true contribute. Deleted timelogs are excluded.

non_billable_hours.description:
Aggregated non-billable work hours for this task group.

Computed from timelogs where billable is false. Represents internal or administrative work not charged to clients. Rounded to two decimal places.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = false THEN erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2). Only timelogs where billable is false contribute. Deleted timelogs are excluded.

entry_count.description:
Number of individual timelog entries aggregated into this task group.

Represents the count of distinct timelog records that contributed to the hour totals. Each timelog entry counts as one regardless of its duration. Useful for understanding the granularity of logged work within each task.
entry_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) of erp_hrm_timelogs records in the group. Each individual timelog row contributes 1 to this count regardless of its duration. Deleted timelogs are excluded. Distinct timelogs counted — not distinct dates, employees, or any other grouping.

IErpHrmTimeReport.ITaskGroup.description:
A task-grouped entry in the aggregated time report, summarizing logged work hours for a specific task or unassigned timelogs within the organization.

When the time report is grouped by task, each entry represents all timelogs associated with a single task — or the collective unassigned timelogs not linked to any task. Hour totals distinguish billable from non-billable work, and the entry count indicates how many individual timelog records were aggregated.

A null taskId with the title "Unassigned" identifies the synthetic group for timelogs that have no task assignment, ensuring complete coverage of all logged hours in the reporting period.
IErpHrmTimeReport.ITaskGroup.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation variant for the time report when grouped by task.

**Data Sources**:
- erp_hrm_timelogs (primary source: duration_minutes, billable, task_id, deleted_at)
- erp_hrm_tasks (joined via task_id: id, title)

All data scoped to the member's active organization via employee → organization chain. Deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) are excluded from all aggregations.

**Discriminator**: group_by = 'task' (const).

**Aggregation Pipeline**:
1. Filter erp_hrm_timelogs by organization scope, date range, and deleted_at IS NULL.
2. LEFT JOIN erp_hrm_tasks ON erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id = erp_hrm_tasks.id.
3. GROUP BY erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id (a null grouping key forms the "Unassigned" synthetic group).
4. Compute per-group aggregates:
   - entry_count = COUNT(*)
   - total_hours = ROUND(SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2)
   - billable_hours = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2)
   - non_billable_hours = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2)
5. Populate taskId from joined erp_hrm_tasks.id, or null for the null-keyed group.
6. Populate title from joined erp_hrm_tasks.title, or the literal string 'Unassigned' for the null-keyed group.

**Edge Cases**:
- Timelogs with null task_id produce a synthetic group with taskId: null and title: 'Unassigned'.
- Groups with zero matching timelogs may still appear with all metrics at zero.
- Deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) are excluded from aggregation.

weekStartDate.description:
Monday date of this ISO week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Represents the first day (Monday) of the ISO 8601 week that this aggregation covers. Derived from the timelog dates that fall within this week.
weekStartDate.x-autobe-specification: Derived from the ISO week grouping of erp_hrm_timelogs.date. Set to the Monday date of the grouped ISO week. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

weekEndDate.description:
Sunday date of this ISO week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Represents the last day (Sunday) of the ISO 8601 week that this aggregation covers.
weekEndDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed as weekStartDate + 6 days (Sunday of the same ISO week). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

totalHours.description:
Total hours logged across all timelogs in this week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations (in minutes) divided by 60. Includes both billable and non-billable time from all employees with timelogs in the week.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 across all timelogs whose date falls within this ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

billableHours.description:
Total billable hours logged in this week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as the sum of durations for timelogs marked as billable within the week. Represents client-chargeable or revenue-generating work time.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true across all timelogs in this ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

nonBillableHours.description:
Total non-billable hours logged in this week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as totalHours minus billableHours. Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as totalHours − billableHours. Represents timelogs where erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = false. Rounded to 2 decimal places.

totalTimelogs.description:
Total number of timelog records within this ISO week.

A simple count of all timelog entries that fall within the Monday-to-Sunday date range, regardless of duration, billable status, or employee.
totalTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records whose date falls within this ISO week.

projectBreakdown.description:
Per-project breakdown of hours and timelog counts for this week.

Each entry summarizes time spent on one project during the week. Projects with no timelogs in the week are omitted from the array.
projectBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: GROUP BY erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id across all timelogs in this ISO week. For each project: compute totalHours (SUM(duration_minutes) / 60), billableHours (SUM WHERE billable = true / 60), timelogCount (COUNT). Join erp_hrm_projects to retrieve projectName. Projects with zero timelogs in the week are omitted from the array.

employeeBreakdown.description:
Per-employee breakdown of hours and timelog counts for this week.

Each entry summarizes one employee's total logged time during the week. Employees with no timelogs in the week are omitted. Includes deactivated employees' historical data for complete reporting accuracy.
employeeBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: GROUP BY erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id across all timelogs in this ISO week. For each employee: compute totalHours (SUM(duration_minutes) / 60), billableHours (SUM WHERE billable = true / 60), timelogCount (COUNT). Join erp_hrm_employees and erp_hrm_members to retrieve employeeName. Employees with zero timelogs in the week are omitted. Includes deactivated employees' historical data.

IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IWeek.description:
A single ISO week entry in the weekly summary report, aggregating all timelogs within a Monday-to-Sunday period.

Contains the week's date range, total hours (with billable vs non-billable split), total timelog count, and per-project and per-employee breakdowns. All hour values are rounded to 2 decimal places.
IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IWeek.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate type representing one ISO week (Monday–Sunday) of time tracking data across the organization.

Source tables: erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes, billable, date), erp_hrm_employees (id, name via erp_hrm_members), erp_hrm_projects (id, name).

Computation per week:
- weekStartDate: Monday of the ISO week derived from GROUP BY on timelog dates
- weekEndDate: Sunday of the ISO week (weekStartDate + 6 days)
- totalHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places
- billableHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places
- nonBillableHours: totalHours − billableHours
- totalTimelogs: COUNT of timelog records within the ISO week
- projectBreakdown: GROUP BY project_id; compute per-project totalHours, billableHours, timelogCount; join erp_hrm_projects for projectName. Projects with zero timelogs are omitted.
- employeeBreakdown: GROUP BY employee_id; compute per-employee totalHours, billableHours, timelogCount; join erp_hrm_employees and erp_hrm_members for employeeName. Employees with zero timelogs are omitted. Deactivated employees' historical data is included.

Data isolation: Scoped to the member's currently selected organization via erp_hrm_timelogs → erp_hrm_employees.organization_id.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the organization.

The organization's UUID as stored in erp_hrm_organization_id columns across all organization-scoped entities (employees, departments, projects, roles, etc.). This id is used to select the active organization context and to scope all subsequent API requests for data isolation.
id.x-autobe-specification: Resolved from erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id. UUID format, always present — every organization has a unique identifier assigned at creation. This is the organization UUID stored in the employee record's organization reference FK column.

name.description:
Display name of the organization.

The primary label identifying the organization throughout the platform. Shown in the organization selection interface, header bars, and all organization-scoped views. Must be unique within the platform.
name.x-autobe-specification: Organization display name as defined during sign-up. Required field — every organization must have a name. Shown as the primary identifier in the organization selection screen. Resolved from the organization context through the employee's organization reference.

description.description:
Optional free-text description of the organization's purpose or mission.

Provides additional context when selecting an organization. May be null when the organization was created without a description.
description.x-autobe-specification: Optional free-text description of the organization's purpose or mission. Nullable — null when no description was provided during sign-up or when explicitly cleared via settings update. Resolved from the organization context through the employee's organization reference.

logo_image.description:
Optional URI pointing to the organization's logo image.

Used for visual identification in the organization selection interface. When set, this image is displayed alongside the organization name. When null, a default placeholder is rendered by the client.
logo_image.x-autobe-specification: Optional URI pointing to the organization's logo image for visual branding. Nullable — null when no logo was uploaded during sign-up. When updated via organization settings, the previously stored logo is replaced. Resolved from the organization context through the employee's organization reference.

IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an organization for the organization selection interface.

Provides the essential identity fields needed to display each organization the authenticated member belongs to: the organization's unique identifier, display name, optional description, and optional logo image. Used in the authorization response's organizations array to render the organization selection screen after login or token refresh.

Operational settings such as currency, timezone, and fiscal start month are excluded from this summary — they are available through the organization detail endpoint. The description and logo image are nullable; organizations created without a description or logo return null for those fields.
IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Resolved from the organization context identified by erp_hrm_organization_id in the member's employee records. No dedicated organizations table is accessible at this layer — the organization identity fields (id, name, description, logo_image) are sourced from the organization service through the employee record's organization reference. The id is the organization UUID stored in erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id. All four fields are identity attributes: name (required display name), description (optional free-text), logo_image (optional URI for branding). Operational settings (currency, timezone, fiscal_start_month) are excluded — they belong in the full organization detail response, not this summary used for the selection screen.

employeeName.description:
Display name of the employee who logged time during this week.

Retrieved from the employee's member profile (erp_hrm_members.display_name). This is the global display name shared across all organizations the member belongs to, providing a consistent identifier regardless of which organization context is active.
employeeName.x-autobe-specification: Computed from erp_hrm_members.display_name via JOIN chain: erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id → erp_hrm_employees.id → erp_hrm_employees.member (relation: erp_hrm_member_id → erp_hrm_members.id). Retrieves the employee's global display name for identification in report views without exposing internal identifiers.

totalHours.description:
Total hours logged by this employee during the week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations in minutes divided by 60. Includes both billable and non-billable time entries, providing a complete picture of the employee's logged work hours for the ISO week.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for this employee's timelogs within the ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs. Scoped to the employee's timelogs within the organization via erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id → erp_hrm_employees.organization_id.

billableHours.description:
Total billable hours logged by this employee during the week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as the sum of durations for timelogs marked as billable within the ISO week. Represents client-chargeable work time and is used in project budget comparisons and revenue tracking reports.

Non-billable time: Timelogs with billable set to false are excluded from this total but are included in totalHours.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true for this employee's timelogs within the ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places. Only timelogs explicitly marked as billable are included. Non-billable timelogs are excluded from this total. Scoped to the employee's timelogs within the organization.

timelogCount.description:
Total number of individual timelog entries recorded by this employee within the ISO week.

A simple count of all timelog records regardless of duration or billable status. Provides a measure of logging frequency — an employee with many short entries will have a high count even if totalHours is moderate.
timelogCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this employee within the ISO week. A simple row count regardless of duration_minutes value or billable status. Scoped to the employee's timelogs within the organization.

IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IEmployeeBrea.description:
Per-employee breakdown of hours and timelog counts within a single ISO week.

Summarizes one employee's total logged time during a Monday-to-Sunday ISO week, split into billable and non-billable hours, along with the count of individual timelog entries.

Aggregation scope: All timelogs within the week for the employee are aggregated regardless of project or task association. Both billable and non-billable time is included in the total hours, with billable hours tracked separately for client-chargeable reporting.
IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IEmployeeBrea.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate type representing one employee's time tracking data within a single ISO week.

Source tables: erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes, billable, employee_id, date), erp_hrm_employees (id, erp_hrm_member_id), erp_hrm_members (display_name).

Computation per employee:
- employeeName: erp_hrm_members.display_name via JOIN erp_hrm_employees → erp_hrm_employees.member (relation: erp_hrm_member_id → erp_hrm_members.id)
- totalHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for this employee within the ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs.
- billableHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true for this employee within the ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places.
- timelogCount: COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this employee within the ISO week, regardless of duration or billable status.

Data isolation: Scoped to the member's currently selected organization via erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id → erp_hrm_employees.id → erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id.

Deactivated employees: Historical timelogs of deactivated employees are included for complete reporting accuracy. Employees with zero timelogs in the week are omitted from the parent array.

projectId.description:
Unique identifier of the project.

References the project in erp_hrm_projects that time was logged against during this week. Acts as the grouping key for the aggregate computation.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Computed as erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id from the GROUP BY key. The project must have at least one timelog in the ISO week to appear in results. Scoped to the member's selected organization via erp_hrm_timelogs → erp_hrm_employees.organization_id.

projectName.description:
Display name of the project.

Retrieved from erp_hrm_projects.name for human-readable identification in report views. The project name as it appears throughout the system.
projectName.x-autobe-specification: Resolved via JOIN: erp_hrm_projects.name WHERE erp_hrm_projects.id = erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id. Retrieved from the projects table for human-readable display in report views.

totalHours.description:
Total hours logged against this project during the week.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations in minutes divided by 60, rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable time, providing a complete view of all work performed on the project during the week.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places. Aggregates all timelog durations for the project within the ISO week regardless of billable status. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

billableHours.description:
Total billable hours logged against this project during the week.

Subset of totalHours representing client-chargeable or revenue-generating work time. Rounded to 2 decimal places for consistency with other hour values in the report.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places. Subset of totalHours representing client-chargeable work. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

nonBillableHours.description:
Total non-billable hours logged against this project during the week.

Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time. Computed as the difference between totalHours and billableHours, ensuring the two categories always sum to the total.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as totalHours − billableHours, rounded to 2 decimal places. Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time. Derived arithmetically rather than via a separate database query for consistency.

timelogCount.description:
Number of individual timelog records for this project within the week.

A simple count of all timelog entries regardless of duration or billable status. Provides visibility into how many separate time entries make up the total hours.
timelogCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this project within the ISO week. A simple row count regardless of duration or billable status. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IProjectBreak.description:
Per-project breakdown of hours and timelog counts within a single ISO week.

Summarizes all time logged against one project during the Monday-to-Sunday week period. Includes the project identifier and display name, total hours with a billable/non-billable split, and the count of individual timelog records.

All hour values are rounded to 2 decimal places for precision and consistency.
IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IProjectBreak.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate type representing time tracking data for one project within an ISO week.

Source tables: erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes, billable, date, project_id), erp_hrm_projects (id, name).

Computation per project within the week:
- projectId: erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id from the GROUP BY key
- projectName: erp_hrm_projects.name via JOIN on project_id
- totalHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places
- billableHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places
- nonBillableHours: totalHours − billableHours, rounded to 2 decimal places
- timelogCount: COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this project in the ISO week

Data isolation: Scoped to the member's currently selected organization via erp_hrm_timelogs → erp_hrm_employees.organization_id. Only projects with at least one timelog in the week are included.

instruction:
# E2E Test Requirements for ERP HRM & Time Tracking Platform

Generate comprehensive E2E test suites that validate all API endpoints and business logic. Tests must cover:

## Auth & User Flows
- Sign up with valid/invalid email and password
- Login with correct/incorrect credentials
- Organization context selection and switching
- Password change (valid, invalid current password)
- Profile update
- Account deletion with ownership transfer validation

## Organization Lifecycle
- Create organization during signup
- Update organization settings
- Delete organization validation: blocked if pending timesheets exist, blocked if active contracts exist, successful when clean

## Role & Permission Enforcement
- Built-in roles cannot be deleted
- Custom role CRUD with permission sets
- Cannot delete role with assigned employees
- Permission checks: unauthorized users receive 403 on protected endpoints
- Role assignment changes

## Employee Management
- Invite by email (new user gets pending invitation, existing user gets immediate addition)
- Cancel pending invitation
- List employees with pagination, filtering (department, employment type, status), name search
- Edit employee record
- Deactivate employee (verify they cannot log time or submit timesheets)
- Reactivate employee

## Employee Contracts
- Create contract (auto-ends previous active contract)
- List historical contracts
- Past contracts are immutable (update should fail)
- Only one active contract at a time

## Department Management
- Create department with/without parent
- Delete department (employee department set to null)
- Nested department listing

## Project Operations
- CRUD operations
- Archive/complete project (verify no new timelogs allowed)
- Delete project with timelogs (should fail)
- Delete project without timelogs (should succeed)
- Filtering by status

## Project Members
- Assign/remove employees
- Project lead vs member role distinction
- Project lead task management permissions

## Task Management
- CRUD with all fields
- Status change records history entry
- Subtask nesting (one level only - validate)
- Filter and sort capabilities
- Permission: project lead can edit tasks in their project

## Time Tracking — Timelogs
- Create timelog (validates project membership, task belongs to project)
- Edit timelog blocked when in approved timesheet
- Delete timelog blocked when in submitted/approved timesheet
- Filter by date range, project, task, billable
- Permission: employee can only create for self, manager can edit/delete any

## Time Tracking — Timesheets
- Draft creation auto-includes week's timelogs
- Cannot submit empty timesheet
- Cannot submit if duplicate week timesheet already submitted/approved
- Add/remove timelogs from draft
- Submit → Approve flow (verifies timelogs locked)
- Submit → Reject flow (returns to draft, requires reason)
- Approve → timelogs become immutable

## Timer (Live Tracking)
- Start timer (only one active per employee)
- Stop timer creates timelog with correct duration
- Discard timer creates no timelog
- Update running timer
- View current timer

## Reports
- Time Report: group by employee/project/task, filter by date/project/billable
- Project Budget Report: budget vs actual, excludes non-budget projects
- Weekly Summary: week-by-week breakdown

## Activity Log
- Verify all specified actions are logged
- Filter by action type, user, date range
- Pagination

## Dashboard
- Personal dashboard returns correct aggregated data
- Organization dashboard returns correct metrics

## Data Isolation (Critical)
- User in Organization A cannot access Organization B data (employees, projects, timelogs, timesheets, reports)
- Cross-organization access returns 404 or 403
- Organization context enforced on every request

## Edge Cases
- Pagination boundary (first page, last page, empty results)
- Concurrent operations (two timers, duplicate timesheet submission)
- Validation errors (missing required fields, invalid enum values)
- Deactivated employee restrictions

import { IEntity } from "@ORGANIZATION/PROJECT-api/lib/structures/IEntity";
import { IErpHrmTask } from "@ORGANIZATION/PROJECT-api/lib/structures/IErpHrmTask";
import { DeepPartial } from "@ORGANIZATION/PROJECT-api/lib/typings/DeepPartial";
import { ArrayUtil, RandomGenerator } from "@nestia/e2e";
import { randint } from "tstl";
import typia, { tags } from "typia";

/**
 * Prepare random ERP HRM task creation data for E2E testing.
 *
 * Generates a complete IErpHrmTask.ICreate with randomized values for all
 * properties. The title is generated using RandomGenerator.paragraph to
 * produce realistic task names. Optional fields include a multi-paragraph
 * description, a random workflow status, priority level, estimated hours
 * with positive bounds, and a date-time formatted due date.
 *
 * Reference fields for assigned employee and parent task use UUID format.
 * When overridden via DeepPartial input, provided values take precedence
 * over random defaults, allowing tests to pin specific relationships or
 * attributes while keeping other fields random.
 */
export function prepare_random_erp_hrm_task(
  input?: DeepPartial<IErpHrmTask.ICreate>,
): IErpHrmTask.ICreate {
  return {
    title: input?.title ?? RandomGenerator.paragraph({ sentences: 3 }),
    description:
      input?.description ?? RandomGenerator.content({ paragraphs: 2 }),
    status:
      input?.status ??
      RandomGenerator.pick([
        "open",
        "in-progress",

scenario.draft: Verify that a valid refresh token obtained from a prior join operation can be successfully exchanged for a new JWT token pair. scenario.draft: Verify that the system detects and rejects a replay attack where a previously-rotated refresh token is reused. First, join as a guest to obtain the initial refresh token (R1). Then call the refresh endpoint with R1 — this succeeds and returns a new refresh token (R2), which invalidates R1 via token rotation. Now call the refresh endpoint again with the original R1 token (the one that was already consumed). The system must detect that R1 has already been rotated and return 401 Unauthorized. This validates the single-use nature of refresh tokens and the replay attack prevention mechanism, which is critical for session security.

scenario.draft:
Register a new member account with a unique email address, a password meeting strength requirements (minimum 8 characters, at least one letter and one digit), and a non-empty display name. Include all required session context fields: href (full page URL), referrer (HTTP Referer header), and optionally ip (IPv4 address).

Verify the response returns HTTP 201 with a complete IErpHrmMember.IAuthorized body containing:
- id: a valid UUID identifying the newly created member
- email: matches the submitted email exactly
- display_name: matches the submitted display name exactly
- avatar_image: null (new members have no avatar)
- phone_number: null (new members have no phone number)
- created_at: ISO 8601 timestamp set to the current time
- updated_at: ISO 8601 timestamp matching created_at (just created)
- token.access: a non-empty JWT access token string
- token.refresh: a non-empty JWT refresh token string distinct from the access token
- token.expired_at: a future ISO 8601 timestamp (access token expiration)
- token.refreshable_until: a future ISO 8601 timestamp beyond expired_at (refresh token expiration)
- organizations: an empty array [] (newly registered members have not yet joined any organization)

Confirm that the returned access token can be used as a Bearer token in the Authorization header on a subsequent authenticated request (e.g., GET /erpHrm/member/dashboard/personal), proving the member was immediately authenticated without requiring a separate login step.

Verify that the contract listing endpoint returns all non-deleted contracts across the organization with correct default behavior.

**Setup:**
1. Join as a new member to establish an authenticated session and organization context with built-in roles.

**Test — Default listing:**
Call the contract index endpoint with no filters (only default pagination). Verify:

- Each contract in the list includes all expected fields: `id`, `employee` (with member profile summary), `start_date`, `end_date`, `pay_rate`, `pay_period`, `working_hours_per_week`, `is_active`, and `created_at`.

- Results are sorted by `start_date` in descending order by default (most recent contract first).

**Test — Pagination boundary:**
Call with `page: 1, limit: 10`. Verify `pagination.current` is 1, `pagination.limit` is 10, and `pagination.records` matches the total count.

# Implementation Instructions for ERP HRM & Time Tracking Platform

Implement complete business logic for all API endpoints with production-grade quality.

## Core Principles
- All business rules from requirements must be enforced
- TypeScript strict mode, full type safety
- NestJS best practices (injectable services, guards, interceptors)
- Prisma for all database operations
- Proper error handling with appropriate HTTP status codes
- Organization context enforced on every operation
- Role-based access control on every protected endpoint
- Data isolation between organizations is non-negotiable

## Key Business Rules to Implement

### Organization Deletion
- Check for pending timesheets (status: submitted) — block if any exist
- Check for active employee contracts (end date is null or in future) — block if any exist
- Cascade delete all organization data on successful deletion

### Role & Permission Enforcement
- Three built-in roles (owner, manager, employee) seeded on organization creation
- Built-in roles cannot be deleted or have their names changed
- Custom roles support arbitrary permission combinations
- Permission guard checks on every endpoint

### Contract Management
- Auto-end previous active contract when creating new one (set end_date to day before new start_date)
- Past contracts (end_date < today) are immutable
- Only one active contract per employee at any time

### Timesheet Logic
- Week boundaries: Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59
- Draft creation auto-includes all timelogs for that employee in that week
- Cannot submit empty timesheet
- Cannot submit if another timesheet for same week already submitted/approved
- Approval locks all included timelogs
- Rejection returns to draft with required reason

### Timer Logic
- One active timer per employee max
- Stop creates timelog: date = today, duration = ceil((now - start) / 60) minutes
- Discard removes timer without creating timelog

### Task History
- Record every status change with old status, new status, timestamp, and user

### Activity Log
- Log all specified actions with structured details (JSON)

### Dashboard Aggregation
- Personal: hours today, hours this week, active timer, recent 5 timelogs, current week timesheet, open/in-progress tasks
- Organization: active employee count, total hours this week, pending timesheets, projects over 80% budget, top 5 employees

### Reports
- Time Report: aggregate with dynamic grouping
- Project Budget Report: budget_hours vs actual with percentage
- Weekly Summary: week-by-week aggregation
